GeoNames geographical database, cities15000 data snapshot downloaded 2026-09-22.
Source: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/cities15000.zip
Attribution: GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/)
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Modified for Knight Room: retained name, ASCII name, Chinese alternate names,
country, coordinates, population, administrative area code and GeoNames ID;
rounded coordinates to four decimal places, sorted by population, converted to JSON.
Array format: [names[], countryCode, latitude, longitude, population, admin1Code, geonameID].
GeoNames provides this data as-is, without warranty of accuracy or completeness.
